subtitle: Out Manila · China Southern Airlines
overview: Fly Manila to Guangzhou on China Southern Airlines, then on to Nyingchi in Tibet. You will see Lulang Forest, Basum Tso, the Potala Palace (interior visit), Jokhang Temple, Yamdrok Lake and Tashilhunpo Monastery in Shigatse. Seven nights are in 5-star hotels and one in a 4-star hotel. Oxygen support is provided: an on-board oxygen cylinder, daily oxygen concentrator supply and more.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Dec 17–25 2026 to Dec 17–25 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Lulang Forest Scenic Area: A scenic forest and meadow area in Nyingchi with views of pine forest and mountains.
placeDesc.Lulang Town: A Tibetan-style town near Nyingchi set among forests, visited on the first day in Tibet.
placeDesc.Midui Glacier: A glacier in the Bomi area of Nyingchi; closed from 1 October and replaced by Gawalong Glacier.
placeDesc.Gawalong Glacier: A glacier in the Bomi area of Nyingchi that replaces the Midui Glacier visit while it is closed.
placeDesc.Basum Tso: A high-altitude lake in Nyingchi with a small island, reached by scenic shuttle bus.
placeDesc.Lake Heart Island: A small island in the middle of Basum Tso with a Tibetan monastery.
placeDesc.Tsozong Gongba Monastery: A monastery on an island in Basum Tso.
placeDesc.Nyang River: A river in southeastern Tibet whose valley views the tour enjoys on the way to Lhasa.
placeDesc.Potala Palace: The great hilltop palace of the Dalai Lamas in Lhasa, with an interior visit on this tour.
placeDesc.Jokhang Temple: A major Tibetan Buddhist temple in the old centre of Lhasa, a pilgrimage site.
placeDesc.Barkhor Street: The old market and pilgrim circuit around the Jokhang Temple in Lhasa.
placeDesc.Yamdrok Lake: One of Tibet's large sacred lakes, seen from a viewing platform on the road to Shigatse.
placeDesc.Nyainqentanglha Snow Mountain: A snow-capped mountain range in central Tibet, seen in the distance on the drive to Shigatse.
placeDesc.Karola Glacier: A glacier beside the road between Lhasa and Shigatse, visited at a roadside viewing area.
placeDesc.Manla Reservoir: A reservoir on the road to Shigatse, passed on the drive.
placeDesc.Tashilhunpo Monastery: A large Tibetan Buddhist monastery in Shigatse, home to a huge gilded Maitreya Buddha.
placeDesc.Zhaqi Temple: A temple in Lhasa dedicated to the wealth goddess, visited on the last morning.
